controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-12T18:35:57.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T19:35:57.000Z"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
        AND (message LIKE "*Accepted*" OR message LIKE "*Failed*" OR message LIKE "*authorized_keys*" OR message LIKE "*ssh*")
| STATS total = COUNT(*),
        earliest = MIN(@timestamp),
        latest = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY data_stream.dataset, process.name, message
| SORT total DESC
| LIMIT 30
